title: This isn’t a chase—it’s two people trying to tame a beast.#movie #film #shorts #crime #action #4k
description:
The Man from U.N.C.L.E.‎ (2015)
During the Cold War, CIA agent Napoleon Solo and KGB agent Illya Kuryakin are forced to team up to stop a criminal organization backed by former Nazi elements from obtaining nuclear weapons technology. To track down the missing nuclear scientist Udo Teller, they bring along his daughter Gaby and infiltrate enemy territory. From mutual distrust and constant rivalry, through chases, betrayals, and reversals, the two mortal enemies ultimately become true partners in life and death.
